faq_subtitle: Clear answers so you can start with peace of mind.

faqs.q: Do I need to be good with technology?
faqs.a: No. Catequese Viva was designed to work on your phone and stay simple from the first meeting.

faqs.q: Do I have to register everything at once?
faqs.a: No. You can start with a few catechumens and add the rest later.

faqs.q: Can I start on my own and later move to a parish?
faqs.a: Yes. Start on the Catechist Plan and, as your catechesis grows, move the organization to the Parish Plan.

faqs.q: Do I need a card to try it?
faqs.a: Yes. Stripe asks for a card to start the trial; the charge only happens after 7 days. Cancel in time if you do not want to continue.
Yes. No lock-in and no penalty.
Yes. You can organize the class and take attendance in the browser, with no app to install.
